summary: Expanded the underfollowed lane for AI-linked power and interconnection constraints. The strongest directly evidenced additions are Powell Industries for medium-voltage/custom electrical distribution tied to data-center orders, IES Holdings for data-center infrastructure and custom power solutions, and MYR Group for transmission, distribution, substation, and commercial electrical contracting.
